title: mimid-agent local daemon
description: Local user-agent daemon per decision mimid-1wgh.28: MLS on-device via mimi-mls, local SQLite state; outward JMAP Chat (E2EE) + MLS capability to provider; inward plaintext JMAP Chat server on a 0600 unix socket. Decodes/encodes mimi-content <-> JMAP Message (senderMsgId per R1). Room ops: create group, invite, send/receive.
notes:
Per mimid-1wgh.30: inward plaintext JMAP Chat via crate-jmap jmap-chat-server with an MLS-backed backend impl; outward via jmap-chat-client. See ~/PROJECT/nie daemon for prior art (localhost bearer-token daemon).
2026-10-18 (mimid-1wgh.38): the agent IS the JMAP Chat bridge and there is no TUI. When planning .13, decide the inward transport so stock JMAP Chat clients can connect (loopback HTTP/WebSocket with a per-user token vs 0600 unix socket); AGENTS.md now says 'local endpoint'.
2026-10-18 (mimid-1wgh.39): plan .13 as a library crate mimid-agent-core plus a desktop daemon wrapper; keep daemon/socket/HTTP-server code out of the core so a mobile binding (epic mimid-1wgh.40) can embed it.
From F5 (2026-10-18): the server's Follower::leave() is local only. The agent's leave flow must send the MLS removal (self-remove or a Remove proposal) through the relay, then the server calls leave().
2026-10-18 (Mark): the .13 plan must include an acceptance test that unmodified stock JMAP Chat clients (crate-jmapchat-client, jmap-chat-js) work against mimid-agent, and must settle .38's open transport question (unix socket vs loopback HTTP + WebSocket/EventSource) with that test in mind. Stock clients speak HTTP, so the AGENTS.md agent-socket peer-credential boundary may need adapting (e.g. a per-user local token); that's a decision for the plan. v1 read/mute/pin state is per device (mimid-1wgh.12.29).
2026-10-18 agent requirement (crate-jmap-50, for the .13 plan): the agent fills plaintext Chat.name, description and avatar from the MLS room_metadata (protocol-06 §7.6), since provider names are empty for followed rooms, and turns a stock client's Chat/set of name/description/avatarBlobId into a room_metadata AppDataUpdate via Room/update (room policy permitting; refusals map to forbidden). The stock-client acceptance test checks that a MIMI room shows its name in crate-jmapchat-client and jmap-chat-js.
Acceptance criterion (2026-11-02, from mimid-1wgh.2.25): content-10 §3.3: before using a decoded MimiContent, reject it if its senderUri or roomUri extension is present and not byte-identical (decision mimid-1wgh.5.58) to the authenticated MLS sender URI / room URI.
